prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test resulted in a statistically significant win.
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-2.4% overall).
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) tends to have a negative impact, as 3 tests agree after noise correction (-3.6% overall).
New adoption flows (adoption, new_flow) tend to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction (-1.8% overall).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and path selection redesigns (choose_path, redesign) showed no clear effect across tests.
Evidence remains thin for home flows (home, new_flow) with only 1 test, and predictions were consistently overly optimistic.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -1.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -1.1% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +0.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -3.6% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- home, new_flow: +2.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Waiting Status Update: Display explicit desktop preparation progress and background system status while waiting for pet rendering to complete. (why: The home waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s and 3 support emails reported pets failing to show up on desktop after setup.)
1: [finish, redesign] Desktop Controls Grid Quick Reference: Redesign the home intro completion screen into a grid layout that clearly details how to talk to, move, and hide your pet. (why: Finish step completion is only 64.8% and 3 support tickets specifically reported user confusion on how to control or hide pets post-onboarding.)
2: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Sync Assurance Copy: Add clear copy on the path selection screen confirming that both custom and starter pets are saved to your cloud account. (why: Choose path drops 23.8% of users, and 8 support tickets were sent regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Lighting Guidance Hint: Add photo lighting and subject visibility hints directly under the photo uploader. (why: Adoption step has 60.9% completion and support received 3 bug reports about custom pet creation failing or rendering wrong.)
4: [home, new_flow] Background Rendering Companion Preview Flow: Add a companion status inspection sub-screen during the waiting process so users can track desktop background rendering status. (why: Home step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing significant drop-off while users wait blindly for rendering.)
5: [choose_path, new_screen] Desktop Pet Capabilities Overview Screen: Insert a new introductory capabilities screen right before path selection showcasing desktop integration features. (why: Path selection drops 23.8% of users on initial touchpoint who may not yet understand how desktop pets function.)
6: [sign_in, copy] Sign In Existing Pet Restore Notice: Update sign-in screen copy to explicitly explain that signing in restores any previously adopted pets. (why: Sign in step drops 27.1% of users, and support received 8 tickets about pets resetting or missing upon re-authenticating.)
7: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Split Personality Overview: Switch the pick friend screen layout to split layout to present companion personality descriptions alongside visuals. (why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%) and takes a long median duration of 89s as users compare choices.)
8: [finish, notification] Desktop Companion Interaction Alert Option: Include a desktop notification permission toggle on the finish screen so users get alerted when their pet is ready to interact. (why: 35.2% drop off at finish and multiple support complaints indicate users are unsure when or how to interact with the pet.)
9: [choose_path, redesign] Story Centered Desktop Introduction Redesign: Redesign the initial story screen layout to centered layout with high contrast callouts explaining the desktop pet experience. (why: The initial story and path selection flow drops over 23% of first-run users before they reach adoption.)

scores.note: Home step drop-off is relatively low (18.7%), but mean wait time (2336s) and 3 support emails strongly indicate confusion during rendering. Status update is non-intrusive.
Finish loses 35.2% of users and support reports post-onboarding confusion, but layout redesigns overall have shown poor or negative performance.
Choose_path loses 23.8% of users and has 8 support tickets on lost pets. Simple copy change is low risk and config-only.
Adoption has the highest drop-off (39.1%) and 3 bug reports point directly to upload issues. Adding inline guidance hints is low cost and safe.
Home wait time is long, but adding new sub-screens/flows tends to underperform expectations and requires full release.
Inserting a new screen before path selection increases friction; historical data shows new screens average -3.6% lift.
Sign-in step drops 27.1% and has 8 support complaints. Informational copy update avoids the negative impact of sign-in reordering.
Adoption drops 39.1%, but layout redesigns in adoption previously resulted in -1.1% lift and lack support mail evidence.
Finish loses 35.2% and complaints mention uncertainty when pet is ready. A toggle adds functional control without full redesign.
Choose_path redesigns historically yielded +0.1% (flat), and there is no explicit support email pointing to story screen layout issues.
